subject.title: [Feature] Control UI: Support channel-based session view toggle

question: Should OpenClaw build a Control UI-specific channel view toggle now, fold it into the broader sessions workspace design, or narrow this to simple channel filtering first?
rationale: The source has enough channel metadata for a basic grouped or filtered view, but a true merged timeline changes cross-session transcript, privacy, routing, and Gateway protocol semantics that require maintainer UX/API direction.

options.title: Scope Channel Views Here
options.body: Define this issue as the canonical Control UI channel-view feature and require maintainers to choose separated tabs, merged timeline behavior, and any protocol additions before implementation.

options.title: Fold Into Sessions Workspace
options.body: Move the channel-toggle requirements into the broader sessions workspace issue so peek, inline reply, status semantics, and channel views share one design.

options.title: Narrow To Filtering Only
options.body: Implement only a non-persistent channel filter over existing session rows and leave merged timelines for a later product decision.

recommendation.title: Scope Channel Views Here
recommendation.body: Define this issue as the canonical Control UI channel-view feature and require maintainers to choose separated tabs, merged timeline behavior, and any protocol additions before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc is the clearest current-line and recent-area owner for the Control UI/session/protocol source touched by this decision.
